events.name: Professional Championship Bull Riders
events.info: This is the ultimate in extreme sports entertainment. A breathtaking whirlwind of bull riding, barrel racing and even country music acts performing together in one unforgettable venue after another. A live, heart-pounding competition - showcasing the world's best cowboys and cowgirls battling for top prize money and bragging rights.
events.pleaseNote: Kid Prices valid from ages 2-12. There is a maximum of 2 kids per 1 adult purchased The Huntington Center is a cashless venue. We are allowing 12x6x12 CLEAR BAGS and 4.5 x 6.5 clutch purses. No large bags, bookbags or boxes are allowed in the building without prior authorization. Absolutely no Re-Entry allowed! We are also a no smoking or vaping venue.

accessibility.info: Accessible seating available for wheel chairs and companions, as well as limited mobility and sight/hearing impaired. boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Mon & Fri: 10:00am-5:30pm Tues-Thurs: 10:00am-4:00pm Sat and Sun Closed (open only if there is an event)
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Huntington Center is a Cashless venue. This includes Box Office, Concessions, Bar & Vendors. We accept Tap pay, American Express, Discover, Mastercard & Visa.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pick up starting 2 hours prior to show time, with an ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Two parking garages are attached to the Huntington Center; they are the Glass City Center Parking Garage and the Port Lawrence Garage. Glass City Center Garage is accessible from Monroe St. across from Hensville Park. Port Lawrence Garage is accessible from St. Clair at Jefferson. Additional parking is available in surrounding lots. Please visit: https://www.downtowntoledo.org/parking/ for more information on Downtown Parking.

generalInfo.generalRule: The Huntington Center has a new bag policy. We are allowing 12x6x12 CLEAR BAGS and 4.5 x 6.5 clutch purses. No large bags, bookbags or boxes are allowed in the building without prior authorization. Absolutely NO Re-Entry allowed! We are also a NO smoking or vaping venue.
generalInfo.childRule: Children who have celebrated their second birthday or children who will occupy a seat are required to have a ticket for admission. This policy may vary with each show. Childrens shows will require a child who has celebrated their first birthday to have a ticket for admission.

events.name: Monster Jam
events.info: Get ready for the ultimate family day out! With awesome trucks, amazing stunts and action-packed excitement, Monster Jam® is the definition of fun for everyone! You'll be close to the action watching the worlds best drivers tear up the dirt and show off crazy skills and all-out racing in fierce head-to-head battles of speed and skill. See the world's most popular trucks like Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco, Sparkle Smash and more only at Monster Jam. Be loud, cheer hard and watch these Monster Jam trucks do the impossible. Its too fun to miss!
